problem.badge: What we see on the ground
problem.title: The challenges holding back your transformation
problem.subtitle: In West Africa, digital transformation runs into specific obstacles that generic solutions don't solve.
problem.problem1Desc: Data scattered across Excel, standalone software, and manual processes. Every decision requires tedious reconciliation.
problem.problem2Desc: Standard ERPs don't cover OHADA, UEMOA taxation, or Ivorian labor law. Costly custom development keeps piling up.
problem.problem3Desc: Solutions designed for other markets, misaligned support, foreign-currency costs, and response times that slow your business down.
problem.problem4Desc: Rapid digital growth exposes organizations to real risks. Without DevSecOps or monitoring, the attack surface grows silently.
problem.footerNote: At AKILI Labs, we turn these obstacles into growth levers, with solutions calibrated for the African context.

socialProof.testimonial1Quote: AKILI Labs transformed our OHADA accounting management with Odoo. Our teams' skills improved remarkably, and closing times were cut in half.
socialProof.testimonial2Quote: Their DevSecOps approach secured our CI/CD pipeline and sped up our releases. A responsive team that understands the challenges of a modern IT department in Africa.
socialProof.testimonial3Quote: The Odoo HRIS module deployed by AKILI Labs covers all our payroll and leave management needs, with full compliance with Ivorian labor law. A trusted partner.
